description: Original CVS English smoke and listening samples.

samples.text: A quiet morning begins beyond the station window.
Platform Seven opens at 10:45, beside the Nova Research Annex.
We made it! I knew the last signal would guide us home.
The archive had been silent for years. When the final lamp flickered on, every map on the wall pointed toward the same forgotten harbor.
I found the letter beneath the old clock.
The handwriting was familiar, but the date made no sense.
